line: 偐. ilunga lehlombe, ngakwesokudla can be held up to be admired, or held up so the person is not crushed. Pride needs someone lower. Dignity lets them stand. Read it from the inside out. The cure is already inside the harm, facing the wrong way.
practice: Do not use this part of the house to make another person smaller. Take the lower seat once.

z: 偓 ilunga lendololwane, izintambo eziseceleni, ingalo, maphakathi
line: 偓. ilunga lendololwane, izintambo eziseceleni, ingalo, maphakathi looks, and the look can steal or it can bless. Envy is love that demands the good thing shrink. Admiration lets it shine. Read it from the inside out. The cure is already inside the harm, facing the wrong way.
practice: Name the exact good you wanted for yourself, out loud, and leave it with the person who has it.
